shared.doc: /** 📚️ The shared types of the artifact crate pack planner: the crate under construction and the moved root item unit. */

files.doc: /** 📥️ The crate source folding, the carve slices and the root item index of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: readCrateSource
phases.doc: Reads the manifest and the crate root source, folds the mount trees and applies the test, lift and inline transforms.

phases.name: buildCarveSlices
phases.doc: Converts mutation leaves, collects the declaration tree and builds the carvable slices with their gates and wrappers.

phases.name: indexRootItems
phases.doc: Indexes the crate root items: extern rows, gated uses, use targets, regions and the measurement root.

files.doc: /** 🧲️ The mirror measurement closures, the slice infos and the chain ownership lookups of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: defineMirrorMeasurement
phases.doc: Defines the unit, cut overlay, wrapper spec and measurement closures that mirror one set of slices as a crate.

phases.name: collectSliceInfos
phases.doc: Collects the coherence types, trait names, type definitions and one info per carvable slice.

phases.name: defineChainOwnership
phases.doc: Indexes the owners of declaration paths and defines the member visibility, source text and shim lookups of path chains.

files.doc: /** 🔗️ The slice edge resolution and the root item closures of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: resolveSliceEdges
phases.doc: Resolves the library and test edges, root references and coherence of every slice info.

phases.name: closeRootItemReferences
phases.doc: Computes the transitive closure of the root items every slice references and picks the closest owners.

files.doc: /** 🧵️ The root item weaving, the component merging and the blockers of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: planRootItemWeaving
phases.doc: Plans which root module items are woven into the slices and which tests are dropped.

phases.name: mergeCoupledComponents
phases.doc: Merges slices that are coupled by coherence, import cycles and file chains into components.

phases.name: collectComponentBlockers
phases.doc: Groups the merged slices into components and collects the blockers that keep a component from being carved.

files.doc: /** 🗜️ The component layering and the packing of components into crates of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: prepareComponentPacking
phases.doc: Layers the components by dependency depth and defines the group, acyclicity and mirror validity helpers.

phases.name: packComponents
phases.doc: Packs the components into crate groups by the measured budget.

files.doc: /** 🚚️ The root items that move into crates and their hosting in the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: findMovedRootItems
phases.doc: Finds the root items that move into the crates the groups reference.

phases.name: pieceMovedRootItems
phases.doc: Cuts the moved items into pieces and computes their dependencies.

phases.name: buildMovedUnits
phases.doc: Builds the moved units from the strongly connected pieces.

phases.name: hostMovedUnits
phases.doc: Assigns every moved unit a hosting crate.

files.doc: /** 🏗️ The crate drafts, their names and their mirrored files of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: draftCrates
phases.doc: Drafts one crate per group and labels the drafts.

phases.name: nameAndPlaceCrates
phases.doc: Names every draft crate, picks its directory and plans its dependencies.

phases.name: renderCrateMirrors
phases.doc: Renders the mirrored files of every planned crate and resolves their moved item appends.

files.doc: /** 🖇️ The root edits and the final plan of the artifact crate pack planner. */

phases.name: collectRootEditsAndPlan
phases.doc: Collects the root edits, file cuts and woven exports and assembles the crate plan.
